notes: THE DEFECT (10-14 21:32-21:36Z, hive-d, base build 5e66386): `mine` (target y55/y56), started from the junk well's stand, dug the well's own wall and floor (9 _dig_town rows inside the shell of the well at 79,57,76); the bot then collected the shaft's items (9 _well_recollected rows). That event REVERTED wellsite-02 as a false trip (a control-arm event; wellread fixed to canary-only, md5 b0cd8a4b). ES 10-08..10-15: _dig_town rows inside a well shell by mine 9 (all hive-d), gather 6 + reflex 4 (board-b), build_well 4 (the builder's own shaft); a 48 h walk (10-13 02:31Z..10-15 02:31Z, 2.72M rows, 22,299 mine rows) has 216 mine rows ending within 8 of a known cap across 8 pools. THE CHANGE (bots/src/minewell.mjs + skills.mjs `mine`, +198/-5): the shell is wellBreakCost's keep-out box (+-2 around the well column, cap.y-3..cap) -- the pathfinder already prices it, but `mine` calls bot.dig directly and ignored it. Before the first dig every bearing's whole stair (to goalY) is simulated against every known well (read fresh, not the 20 s snapshot); a bearing that touches a shell is not allowed. With no clear bearing the bot WALKS (pathfinder, 20 s, at most 2 tries, a failed target excluded from the next plan) to the nearest standable start within 8 (else 16), never within 12 of home, and plans again; only then a forbidden refusal naming `explore away from the well`. Inside a well the refusal names the rim (`goto` it): escape stays possible. Every dig of the descent -- first cut, the falling-block re-open, the tread re-dig -- re-reads the shell immediately before bot.dig (after equip) and stops with a forbidden naming the cell. Rows: _mine_well_guard action=relocate|refuse|stop at=<cap> from=<cell> [to=<cell>]. TESTS: npm test 252/252 at 20e77d3b (+ test-only nit 6658bb77, minewell suites 2/2); test/minewell.test.mjs (27, incl. the refusal->relocate->retry CHAIN, the re-open and re-dig re-checks, inside-the-well rim remedy, stale-snapshot) + test/minewell-home.test.mjs (2); 12 in-suite mutants, anchors asserted present and unique. REVIEWS: Codex r1-r4, Claude r1-r4; both APPROVE at 20e77d3b (bots/src identical at a8af87db; later commits touch the read and a test only). LINT: eslint no-undef on the tip: exactly the one pre-existing reflex.mjs 'withinBody' (typeof-guarded; also on plain 5e663860); minewell.mjs, skills.mjs, the tests: 0. NOT COVERED (stated, not gated): diggers other than `mine` (gather, reflex, airpocket, path-watchdog, ~12 other dig sites in skills.mjs) -- gather/reflex dug board-b's shell 10 times in the same week; a well not yet recorded or recognised; ground below cap.y-3.

licence.note: Only this build writes _mine_well_guard. It fires only when a planned stair would touch a known shell (relocate/refuse) or a descent reaches one (stop): in a drawn pool with a well, mine runs end within 8 of the cap ~4-30 times a day (48 h walk above), so the licence may take hours; the extension runs until exposure.

require.name: a live junk well in use (disposals)

draw_exposure.note: The guard can only act in a town with a well. 48 h to 10-15 02:31Z _well_dispose: hive-a 35, placebo-d 36, hive-b 29, hive-c 28, placebo-a 28, placebo-b 17; hive-d 2, board-b 1 (wells, rarely used); the other 8 pools have no well and cannot expose the change.

exposure.note: Ready = >= 3 canary guard rows that ACTED (relocate or stop) AND >= 1 control mine row ending within 8 of a known cap (the population the guard targets is present in the window).

own_lines.note: G1: a CANARY _dig_town row by mine (purpose target) at a cell inside the shell (+-2, cap.y-3..cap) of a well its own pool knows (caps from the pool's well rows, pre and post; a cap cut off by the 300-char detail cap is refused). Positive control: the same function, dry run on hive-d 10-14 20:00-23:00Z on the base build: 9 (the defect's own rows); self-tests on the hive-d row strings run on every read.
Leak check: a CONTROL _mine_well_guard row means the control is not running the base. BLOCKS KEEP (no evidence key: a mis-deployed control is not a defect of this change).
junkwell-02 C1 (canary arm only since b0cd8a4b): an item collected out of a well's shaft -- the defect's own consequence.
junkwell-02 C4 (a bot stuck inside a well >= 2 min): the guard refuses `mine` inside a well; escape must stay possible (the refusal names the rim).

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: mine success share DiD; canary guard rows by action; canary well refusals per mine run (forbidden + names the junk well). A relocate that adds walking may lower mine throughput slightly near wells; dry runs on the base: DiD +0.16/+0.21 on 3 h cross-sections, i.e. the noise band is wide.
